message.content:
Explore the about page HTML and SCSS for the NINEONELABS renewal project at c:\Users\edn_y\renew_nineonelabs\.

Focus on:
1. Full content of views/pages/about/index.php — especially all sections with class "no-sub-about-section", their data-scene attributes, existing content
2. resource/scss/pages/_sub.scss — look for .no-sub-about-* rules
3. resource/scss/pages/ — any about-specific SCSS file
4. resource/scss/components/_modal.scss, _button.scss — to understand animation/reveal patterns already in use
5. resource/scss/base/_utils.scss — look for animation utilities, fluid(), mq() usage

Report: full section list in index.php with their classes/data attributes, existing SCSS for .no-sub-about-gallery and .no-sub-about-proof, any existing text reveal or pin animation utilities in SCSS.
